resources.string: The experimental method uses the head unit’s USB network. It switches USB mode, stops and records the reason on failure, and restores the original configuration when finished.
Disconnect the current session before changing the method or restoring USB.
After an interrupted experiment or failed recovery, disconnect, unplug the iPhone cable and restore USB here.
USB configuration restored. Reconnect your iPhone before starting.
The head unit control interface is unavailable. The USB connection verification test could not start. Please upload the logs.
A usable USB configuration or controller could not be confirmed. The experiment has stopped. Please upload the logs.
The original USB configuration has not been confirmed restored. Disconnect and unplug the iPhone cable, then select Restore original USB configuration. Upload the logs if recovery still fails.
The iPhone did not complete the USB capability check or role switch. Unlock it, reconnect the cable, retry, and upload the logs.
The USB connection verification test did not complete the connection. Retries stopped and recovery was attempted. Please upload the logs to identify the failed stage.
There is no pending USB configuration to restore. The system was not changed.
